manifest.name: password-input
manifest.title: PasswordInput
manifest.description: A password input with a show/hide button, on InputGroup and Base UI's Input, in Fluent's small, medium and large.
manifest.usage: Use PasswordInput for any secret the user types: a database password, a key passphrase, a token. Put it in a Field with a FieldLabel; with TanStack Form wire value, onValueChange and onBlur to the field like Input. Set autoComplete="new-password" when the user chooses a new secret (the default, "current-password", lets password managers fill a saved one). The show button keeps the name "Show password" (toggleLabel) in both states. For a secret the user should not see at all, use a disabled PasswordInput or no input. Appearance outline is the default; underline for dense or inline forms, filled-darker on white surfaces, filled-lighter on grey ones. The old sizes sm/md/lg still work for one release.

props.name: visible
props.description: Controlled: whether the text is shown.

props.name: onVisibleChange
props.description: Called when the user shows or hides the text.

props.name: toggleLabel
props.description: The show button's accessible name, the same in both states.

props.name: autoComplete
props.description: "new-password" when the user sets a secret.

props.name: appearance
props.description: Fluent's field appearance: outline (a light fill, a hairline and the darker bottom edge), underline (the bottom edge only), filled-darker (color.bg.inset) or filled-lighter (color.bg.surface).

props.name: size
props.description: Fluent's field sizes: 24, 32 and 40 px when comfortable (caption-1, body-1, body-2), 22, 28 and 34 px when compact (size.control.sm, md, lg).

props.name: size (sm, md, lg)
props.description: The old size names, mapped to small, medium and large. Kept for one release.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables the input and the show button.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the frame, merged after the component's own.

slots.name: root
slots.description: The InputGroup frame; data-slot="password-input" and data-size.

slots.name: input
slots.description: The text control, type password or text; data-slot="input-group-input".

slots.name: toggle
slots.description: The show/hide button with aria-pressed; data-slot="input-group-button".

states.name: hover
states.description: Pointer over the show button: color.interactive.hover and color.fg.default.

states.name: visible
states.description: Text shown: the button is pressed and its icon turns color.fg.default.

states.name: focus-visible
states.description: Keyboard focus: Fluent's accent underline (shadow.focus-underline) around the frame (the input) or the button.

states.name: invalid
states.description: In an invalid Field (or with aria-invalid): the frame's border is color.status.danger.border.

states.name: disabled
states.description: Ignores interaction; the frame drops its fill and takes Fluent's disabled stroke and text.

accessibility: The text control is a native <input type="password"> (type="text" while shown), so password managers, paste and autofill work.
The show button is a native <button> after the input in tab order, named "Show password" in both states and with aria-pressed telling whether the text is shown.
Showing the text keeps focus where it was; the value and the caret do not change.
Inside a Field the input takes the label, description and aria-invalid.
Focus shows Fluent's accent underline (shadow.focus-underline) (3:1 on every surface).
